about_the_game:
EvilTrap

Trapped in a cursed village under a night that never ends, you soon realize there is no true refuge.
The forest presses against the streets, its shadows filled with whispers and scratching claws. Demons roam freely, slipping between broken houses and decaying barns, testing every door and window, waiting for the moment you falter. If you’re caught outside, they will drag you into the dark.

You must explore the village and the forest during this endless night to gather supplies, search for clues, and hunt for the fleeting safety of hidden shelters. But every time you reach the outskirts, an unseen force pushes you back, something wants you trapped here forever.

Even inside, the feeling of safety is fragile. Footsteps echo across abandoned rooms. Knocks strike against the walls. A presence peers through cracks and broken shutters. Hide in closets, cellars, or corners swallowed by shadow, and pray the thing outside passes by. One demon, more persistent than the rest, always return, learning your patterns, testing your hiding places, waiting for a single mistake.

EvilTrap delivers an atmospheric psychological horror where the night never ends, the village itself feels alive, and escape is nothing more than a cruel illusion.

🔑 Features

  • Never-Ending Night – no daylight to save you; the cursed village and forest are shrouded in eternal darkness.

  • Psychological & Atmospheric Horror – dread, tension, and paranoia define every moment.

  • Hide to Survive – closets, barns, cellars, and shadows are your only lifeline when the demon hunts.

  • A Living Setting – oppressive audio, shifting shadows, and a village that creaks like it remembers you.
